messages:
dana: idea  Switch Bingo + LAN this Friday in mezz. casual games, mystery key envelopes, and a tiny bingo sheet for goofy challenges. whos in? :joystick:

omar: in. what's Switch Bingo? sounds hilarious.

dana: bingo squares = silly tasks like 'win a 1v1 with a joycon', 'spectate a match', 'bring a weird snack'. first bingo gets to pick a mystery envelope.

lee: count me in. i'll bring a couple of pro controllers and a USB hub.

violet: i'll bring snacks + label things this time. also can do a sign-up sheet.

cory: travel router? last LAN I had NAT pain. I can bring a small one.

poll-bot: POLL by dana  "Start time" Options: "6:30pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Dana (7pm), Omar (7pm), Lee (6:30pm), Violet (7pm), Cory (7pm).

dana: 7pm it is. mezz booked 7-11pm. office-bot check?

office-bot: Mezzanine reserved 7pm-11pm. Please return chairs to stacks and keep noise reasonable after 10:30pm.

violet: sign-up sheet: https://sheets.example.com/s/switch-bingo-signup (I'll pin it). please note if you need a controller.

cory: travel-router quick config if anyone needs it:
```
# travel-router quick
mode=router
enable dhcp
ssid=RedwoodLAN
```

omar: rules: one envelope per person, remote raffle for two envelopes. remote folks can join via the stream and DM answers for scavenger clues.

lee: mini bracket for Smash? casual best-of-3, sign up on the sheet.

dana: bingo prize + mystery key for winner. also tiny silly-hat bonus: wear something silly and get first pick.

oviolet: I'll bring napkins and biodegradable plates. allergy callouts pls label.

office-bot: Reminder: do not move server racks or networking appliances. Keep cables tidy.

dana: final: tidy up, label gear, and no loud music after 10:30. see y'all Friday :partyparrot:
